summary: Scene graph node destructor / resource cleanup. If the head of the first linked list at this+0x204 is non-null, walks the list reading each node's next pointer, unqueues, unlinks and frees every node (QueueResourceCleanup, DoublyLinkedListUnlink, FreeWrapper). Conditionally runs FieldCleanupWithNullCheck when this+0x1EC is set and LinkedNodeDestruction when this+0x1E0 is set. If the second list head at this+0x224 is non-null, walks it via the next pointer at this+0x228, frees every node, then zeroes this+0x224. Frees a 56-byte-stride array at this+0x22C, calling EmptyStub_0170 per element, then zeroes the pointer. Returns 0.

local_names.v2: first linked-list head / current node from this+0x204
local_names.v6: second linked-list head / current node from this+0x224

operations.description: Guard on the first linked-list head at this+0x204 being non-null before draining it.
Walk the first linked list starting at this+0x204, following each node's next pointer (reaches this+0x214); per node: QueueResourceCleanup, DoublyLinkedListUnlink, FreeWrapper.
After the walk drains, run QueueResourceCleanup, DoublyLinkedListUnlink and FreeWrapper once more on the last node.
If this+0x1EC is non-null, call FieldCleanupWithNullCheck(this) for child-resource cleanup.
If this+0x1E0 is non-null, call LinkedNodeDestruction(this) for linked child-resource teardown.
Walk the second linked list at this+0x224 following each node's next pointer (reaches this+0x228), freeing every node with FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Zero this+0x224 after the second list is drained and freed.
For the array at this+0x22C, read the element count stored just before the array base and walk backwards 56 bytes per element; call EmptyStub_0170 for each element.
Free the array base with FreeWrapper_7bcf and zero this+0x22C.
Return 0 at the end of cleanup.

clean_pseudocode: for (node = this->list2_head; node; node = node->next) { FreeWrapper(node); }
for (p = base + count*56; count; count--) { p -= 56; EmptyStub_0170(); }

Next-pointer offsets of the two linked-list node structures are implied by the raw dereferences (this+0x214, this+0x228) but the node type is unnamed.
The child-resource distinction between FieldCleanupWithNullCheck (0x00561940) and LinkedNodeDestruction (0x0054FA50) is not confirmed.
